description: Search the catalog of organization-only datasets, including daily SAM.gov federal contract opportunities, USAspending and SEC filings. Free, no API key. Returns titles, record counts, price per record and a preview. Use listing_id with the REST catalog endpoint to buy records; this tool searches and previews only.

query.description: One or two words matched against dataset titles. Use exact title wording including punctuation, e.g. "SAM.gov", "contract", "awards", "sanctions", "exclusions".

name: search_contracts
